op-mainnet.admission_rule: serialized type-2 transaction length <= 128 KiB and gasLimit <= 2^24; deposits exempt
op-mainnet.da_footprint_formula: max(100, floor((-42585600 + 836500*fastlzSize)/1e6)) * daFootprintGasScalar; zero configured scalar maps to 400
op-mainnet.estimator: FastLZ of complete signed serialized transaction
op-mainnet.finality: Sequencer inclusion is provisional; safe/finalized follows Ethereum L1
op-mainnet.withdrawal: Approximately seven days through the respected CANNON_KONA type-8 fault-proof game
op-mainnet.security_assumption: At least one honest challenger responds to an invalid claim before game clocks expire
op-mainnet.evm_notes: 24,576-byte runtime and 49,152-byte initcode limits; Karst MODEXP/P256VERIFY/BN256-pairing behavior must be audited for the verifier

arbitrum-one.admission_rule: sequencer default tx.Size() <= 95000; delayed Inbox DataTooLarge boundary 117964 is a distinct route
arbitrum-one.execution_fee_formula: L2BaseFee * (executionGas + posterGas); ordinary priority fee collection inactive on One at ArbOS61 activation
arbitrum-one.finality: Sub-second sequencer-trusting soft finality; parent-chain data finality roughly 12-15 minutes
arbitrum-one.withdrawal: 45,818 L1-block BoLD dispute window, approximately 6.4 days, then claim
arbitrum-one.security_assumption: At least one validator checks and challenges; force inclusion period is 5,760 L1 blocks/about 24 hours
arbitrum-one.evm_notes: Solidity runtime remains 24 KiB and initcode 49,152 bytes; 96 KiB Stylus fragments are not an ordinary Solidity-verifier escape hatch

scroll-mainnet.admission_rule: IsValidBlockSizeForMining(tx.Size()) applies 1/0.95 against 120 KiB, giving signed tx <= 116736; gas must fit header
scroll-mainnet.finality: Confirmed is sequencer inclusion; Committed is L1-finalized batch commit; Finalized is L1-finalized validity proof
scroll-mainnet.withdrawal: Executable with Merkle proof after validity finalization; no fixed seven-day fraud window; latency is external
scroll-mainnet.security_assumption: Validity proof plus L1; Euclid enforced inclusion/emergency submission; upgrades controlled by 9-of-12 Security Council
scroll-mainnet.evm_notes: 24,576-byte runtime and 49,152-byte initcode limits; RIPEMD-160 and BLAKE2F disabled, MODEXP components limited to 32 bytes, no blob opcodes/EIP-4788

admission_sweep_gate.conclusion: No selected ordinary sequencer admits the complete 80-210 KiB range.
